notes: TOST margin is post-hoc exploratory; not confirmatory equivalence.
MDE uses observed paired SD and normal power approximation; sensitivity descriptor, not observed power.
IQM integrates central 50% of ten seed means with fractional boundary weights; no episode pseudoreplication.
Common-step overlap is censored by episode length and does not imply equal states or policies.
Full/Periodic lambda=1; RR/DAC lambda=.9 in original harness.
